limits: Lists names and lengths; it opens nothing.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Lists the project's documents; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which sequence documents does the project hold?

description: List the project's sequence documents (id, name, length, topology, kind).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

kind.description: restrict to one document kind (all kinds when unset). Kind is derived from the record itself — `amplicon` is provenance, not a file property, so documents read from disk are never classified as one.

name: list_library

ids.description: just the entry ids, in the same order — the list to scatter a per-document step over

names.description: just the entry names, in the same order
